parts:
Hi Elizabeth,

Thanks for your response & you alerted me to an obvious error in my
code. I think the default settings for GcRmaBackgroundCorrection are
type="fullmodel", which would require the paired PM-MM pairs & I had
tried this model initially. I then used what I assume to be the correct
method by setting type="affinities". To my understanding this should
only use the sequence information & would correspond to the "PM-only EB"
method in the original paper.

Unfortunately I still got the same error when using the brainarray
ENTREZ cdf. The code, output, sessionInfo & traceback is:
